questions.q: What are the two ITIL inputs that determine Priority on an incident?
options: Category and Caller
State and Assignment Group
Impact and Urgency
Resolution Code and Close Notes
questions.explain: Impact (how many are affected) and Urgency (how fast it's needed) are the two ITIL inputs to Priority.

questions.q: What is the real out-of-box table that auto-calculates Priority from Impact and Urgency?
options: sys_choice
priority_lookup_rule
sysrule_assignment
major_incident_state
questions.explain: Each row in priority_lookup_rule maps one Impact x Urgency combination to a Priority value.

questions.q: What happens when an agent sets Impact and Urgency on an incident, if the Priority Lookup Rule is in place?
options: Nothing — the agent must still set Priority manually every time
The incident is automatically closed
Impact and Urgency are reset to blank
The platform looks up the matching rule and sets Priority automatically
questions.explain: The lookup rule matches the Impact x Urgency combination to a row and sets Priority with no manual step.

questions.q: What is the real trade-off between calculated Priority and manual override, per this lesson?
options: Calculated Priority keeps prioritization consistent across agents; manual override adds flexibility but risks inconsistency and needs justification
There is no real trade-off; manual override is always better
Manual override is required by ServiceNow and cannot be disabled
Calculated Priority only works for Impact values, not Urgency
questions.explain: Consistency vs. flexibility is the actual implementation decision — most mature instances keep the calculated default and log overrides.

questions.q: Why should an implementer review the default priority_lookup_rule matrix rather than accept it as-is?
options: The default matrix cannot be changed
To confirm the business's own Impact/Urgency definitions actually match the matrix, and that Priority 1 is reserved for combinations that truly warrant it
Because the matrix has no effect on reporting or SLAs
Because manual override is disabled by default and must be turned on first
questions.explain: A matrix that doesn't match the business's real definitions of Impact/Urgency produces Priority values nobody trusts.
